question: Which of the following is a collection of authoritative terminology originally compiled from IUPAC recommendations published by the scientific divisions of the union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold Book**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **IUPAC Gold Book** is a compilation of **authoritative terminology that was originally collated from IUPAC recommendations published by the scientific divisions of the union**.
 
• This book is a critical resource for **scientific vocabulary and definitions used by the scientific community, particularly in the field of chemistry**.
 
• IUPAC, the **International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry**, is an international federation that represents chemists in individual countries and strives to promote global scientific activity.
 
• The Gold Book is one of many color books published by IUPAC, each serving a different purpose in the field of chemistry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purple Book**: Another publication from IUPAC, the Purple Book officially titled "**Compendium of Polymer Terminology and Nomenclature**" covers terminology, definitions, and nomenclature rules in **pure and applied macromolecular science**.
 
• **Red Book**: Also referred to as "**Nomenclature of Inorganic Chemistry**," the Red Book provides recommendations for the naming of **inorganic compounds**.
 
• **Orange Book**: The Orange Book, officially named "**Compendium of Analytical Nomenclature**," is a collection of recommendations on **analytical terminology**.
